chunks: And from him, from 'Uthman, from سماعة, who said:
I asked him about semen that gets on a garment. He said: “Wash the entire garment if its place is hidden from you, whether it was a little or a lot.”

key_terms.اغْسِلِ: wash; an imperative command indicating the required action
key_terms.الثَّوْبَ: the garment or clothing that has been affected
key_terms.الْمَنِيِّ: semen, the substance discussed here as affecting ritual purity
key_terms.خَفِيَ: became hidden or unknown; indicating uncertainty about the precise location
key_terms.كُلَّهُ: all of it; meaning the entire garment must be washed
key_terms.مَكَانُهُ: its place; the exact spot of the impurity on the garment

ai.seo_question: What should be done if semen gets on a garment and its exact location is unknown?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a garment affected by semen. If the exact spot of the impurity is unknown, the whole garment must be washed, whether the amount is small or large.
